name: The Lost Runner

angles.text: Ensuring the safe communication between the ancient Oracle Tree and the leadership in Darnassus is vital to the security and spiritual guidance of the kaldorei.
Maintaining secure roads and communication lines across Teldrassil supports the stability of Darnassus and Alliance territory.

faq.answer: The missing runner is Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, a night elf sentinel still in training who was tasked with delivering a message from the Oracle Tree to Darnassus.
The Oracle Tree is an ancient tree located in the Oracle Glade that periodically conveys messages to the night elf elders in Darnassus, requiring stationed Sentinels to deliver them safely.
Eralya was expected along the westward road leading between Darnassus and the Oracle Glade, where runners regularly travel to transport communion from the tree.

aliases: who sent sentinels to oracle tree
what is council of the forest
faq.answer: The Council of the Forest assigned a detachment of Sentinels to the Oracle Tree to ensure messages are safely and swiftly relayed to the elders in Darnassus.
faq.q: Who stationed the Sentinels at the Oracle Tree?

aliases: how often does oracle send messages
faq.answer: While communications from the Oracle Tree vary in frequency, her absence has grown abnormally long, prompting concern from her superiors given her trainee status.
faq.q: Why is her absence a concern?

aliases: what do you do in the lost runner
faq.answer: You are asked to head west along the path toward the Oracle Glade to search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow and discover what has delayed her.
faq.q: What is the objective of this search?

sections.body: The Council of the Forest maintains a contingent of Sentinels stationed at the revered Oracle Tree within Teldrassil. The tree conveys sacred messages to the night elf elders, relying on dedicated runners to carry these dispatches back to Darnassus along the winding forest roads. Ensuring these missives arrive safely is essential for the guidance and governance of the kaldorei.
sections.title: Messengers of the Oracle

sections.body: Communication from the Oracle Tree varies in timing, but an unusually long silence raises alarm when a courier fails to appear. The latest duty fell to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, an initiate still undergoing her training. Fearful that misfortune has met her on the trail, her superiors direct travelers to search the westward road toward the Oracle Glade to determine her fate.
sections.title: An Overdue Courier

summary: The Lost Runner is a task to locate Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, an initiate courier overdue from the Oracle Tree. It matters because communications between the sacred tree and the elders in Darnassus are vital to the night elf leadership.
